name: unpruuf-relay
description: Blind store-and-forward relay for unpruuf. Holds already Double-Ratchet-encrypted, outer-AES-wrapped packets addressed only by rotating wire tag; never sees plaintext or contact identity.

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --test dist/app.test.js dist/store/blobStore.test.js dist/connectionString.test.js dist/identity.test.js dist/windowsTor.test.js dist/macTor.test.js dist/torDownload.test.js dist/sqliteNativeBinding.test.js dist/relayEventLog.test.js dist/relayStatus.test.js
